svg.aria-label: Animation: extracting the minimum from a heap and sifting the replacement root downwards
svg.title: Animation: extracting the minimum from a heap and sifting the replacement root downwards
svg.text: The manager leaves; the last hire takes the chair and sinks to their real level
removing the minimum is not removing a node - it is replacing the root and letting it sink back into place

g.text: extract-min returns 2 - the root is the answer
move the last leaf 12 into the root to keep the shape complete
12 > smaller child 5 -> sink. Heap restored in log n steps.
peek O(1) - extract-min O(log n) - insert O(log n) - build-heap from n items O(n)
